displayDescription: Navy halftone field; 'IT CLICKS!' sticker caption slams in with squash and wobble, ring pulse and confetti, then dotted links grow into a system.
styleRenderer: SVG (inline, filter-based sticker keyline + hard shadow)
HTML/CSS (system fonts Impact and Arial Rounded MT Bold via @font-face local())
Rough.js 4.6.6 (seeded, paths pre-generated offline and embedded as static SVG data)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track. Authored cue sequence (visual only): pop 0.12s, slam 0.95s, sticker 1.22s, node arrivals 1.80s and 2.14s.
limitations: Blender was intentionally not used, per user instruction; the scene is flat 2D vector, which matches this style's medium.
Motion and mo.js from the style recommendation were not used: mo.js is not installed, and GSAP owns every animated property to keep one seekable owner.
The sticker keyline and hard shadow are approximated with SVG feMorphology/feOffset filters on a single real-font text element, not separately set outline layers.
Rough.js runs only at authoring time (seed fixed). Its paths are embedded static data, and the doodle wobble is not regenerated at runtime.
No mascot or footage: safe areas were planned against the 1280x720 frame only, not against real face or subtitle footage.
Text contrast: cream label on #668FA3 / #A47CA3 is about 3.2:1. It is used only for large bold text with a dark stroke.

Typography uses OS-bundled macOS fonts (Impact, Arial Rounded MT Bold), declared through @font-face local() sources with no embedded font files. Render hosts without these fonts fall back to Arial Black or a sans-serif.
